environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; storytelling focus; emphasis on family and survival; warm and cozy aesthetics for the sleeping and birth scenes.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left (Birth): A cozy, fur-lined nest inside a hollowed-out log, showing a mother curled around three tiny, pinkish, fuzz-covered pups; Top-Right (Dining): The mammal standing on its hind legs, holding a large, colorful Cretaceous beetle in its paws and taking a bite; Bottom-Left (Sleeping): The mammal curled into a tight 'fuzz-ball' inside a rock crevice, its long tail wrapped around its body like a blanket; Bottom-Right (Playing): Two juvenile mammals 'wrestling' and tumbling over a large, round seed pod on the forest floor.
visual_logic.ground: Varies by quadrant—from soft nest materials (fur/leaves) to the gritty, purple-red silt of the Anacleto floodplain.
visual_logic.lighting: Soft, diffused lighting throughout, with a warm golden 'rim light' in the playing scene to highlight the fluffiness of their fur.
